summary: The world felt alive with dynamic encounters, shifting moods, and reactive NPCs. The game generated two ambushes on entry (Chapel Nave and Vestry Passage), escalated pressure in districts, and provided clear opportunities and rumors. However, combat was punishingly difficult, and some slash commands were poorly handled, causing confusion. The session recap effectively summarized world moves.
